_note: Single source of truth for the agent runtime model (ADR 0008). Eval runs must launch Pi with these values explicitly and record the model Pi actually reports in artifacts/evals/<run_id>/environment.json. A mismatch fails the run.

semantic_judge.tests_and_demo_judge: scripted-fake/1 (offline tests and the verifier demo only; never a measurement)
semantic_judge.rejected_alternative: Pi's ChatGPT OAuth login: it reuses a ChatGPT subscription's OAuth credentials for a third-party tool; no explicit OpenAI policy allows it; account risk.

pi_isolation_note: Mandatory for every scripted Pi launch (smoke, eval runner): allowlist = exactly our 8 tools (no built-in bash/read/write/edit, so the model cannot read .env or ~/.pi/agent/auth.json); only the reviewed extension loads (-ne + explicit --extension); trust-gated project files ignored (-na); no skills/prompt templates. Launchers must refuse to start Pi if any of these is missing. ADR 0008 revision 2026-09-26.
